title: `merge --review-record` output that a lane posts as is parses as a review record
why: Degen PRs 547 and 550, 21:07 CST Nov 8: the output lanes posted started with a banner line, so the merge tool could not read the record. parse_review needs the marker as the exact first line (merge/merge.py), so one line above it voids the record and the batch waits on a re-post. Source of the banner: unmeasured.
note: Filed from Degen cloud coordinator (session_01MVD32QdrtEN15MxhdA1mnU), lane guards-claude-settings, 21:50 CST Nov 8. Fix options: the tool prints the record alone on stdout, or parse_review skips lines above the marker. Decision pr-review-record.
